question: How many orders were placed last month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question: What was our total revenue in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

question: Which category generated the most revenue this year?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 best-selling products by units sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

question: How many customers do we have in each membership tier?
gold_sql: SELECT membership_tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY membership_tier

question: Who are our top 5 highest-value customers by total spend?
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many orders were cancelled this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

question: Which payment method has the most completed payments?
gold_sql: SELECT method FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products are completely out of stock across all warehouses?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT product_id FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(quantity_on_hand) = 0) t

question: What is the total quantity on hand in each warehouse?
gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, SUM(quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse

question: How many return requests were made last month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns WHERE requested_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND requested_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question: What is the most common reason for returns?
gold_sql: SELECT reason FROM returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product has the highest average rating among products with at least 3 reviews?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders came from each sales channel?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: What is the total amount refunded for returns resolved this year?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM returns WHERE status = 'refunded' AND resolved_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

question: Which city has the most customers?

question: How many orders were shipped to countries outside Bangladesh?

question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order this year?

question: Which brand sold the most units last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
